action.public_message: I'll pay the fine and get back on the board.
action.private_thought: I have ample cash (700) and a valuable red monopoly with 3 houses each. Paying the $50 fine is cheap and gets me out immediately, avoiding the 1/6 chance of rolling doubles and losing a turn. Staying in jail offers no rent advantage, so I will pay.

breakdown.message: Leaves a playable reserve after paying.
Chooses movement tempo over passive protection.
Private thought names why exiting matters.
